## Positioning
8PCK is the export desk of CXWN in Shantou, Guangdong. Blow moulding, injection moulding, decoration and assembly sit under one roof at CXWN, with 3,000+ existing moulds — so most custom briefs need no tooling. Customers are distributors and brand owners in the US, EU, Southeast Asia and the Middle East.

## Capabilities
- Factory: 7,142 m², 20 lines, 120 staff, in-house mould shop and QC lab
- Moulds: 3,000+ existing (no tooling cost); new blow mould from USD 800, 15–20 days
- MOQ: 1,000 pcs per colour on existing moulds
- Samples: 7 days on existing moulds
- Production: 25–35 days after sample approval
- Export markets: 40+ countries

## Verification
- Certificate numbers can be checked with the issuing bodies: ISO 9001 PCC85724Q01277R1S (ProCision Shanghai), RoHS B-R01612E2033 (PE) and B-R201133464 (PET), EU 10/2011 E2032 (Beide laboratory).
- Scans: https://8pck.com/verify.html
- The USCC can be checked at gsxt.gov.cn.

## Certifications on file
- ISO 9001:2015 — certificate PCC85724Q01277R1S (ProCision Shanghai), valid to 24 Oct 2027
- RoHS — verification of compliance, 2011/65/EU + (EU) 2015/863
- EU 10/2011 + 1935/2004 — overall migration test, Beide laboratory, report B-R201133481 (PE grades)
- Not held: FDA, REACH SVHC and GRS certificates. PET / PETG declarations are issued per order against the resin supplier's DoC.

## Materials
- PET — clear, stiff, food-grade; 50–1,000 ml bottles (20/410, 24/410, 28/410)
- HDPE — opaque, tough, cheaper per gram; shampoo, detergent, 200–1,000 ml
- PETG — thick-wall clarity; airless packs and premium cosmetic bottles

## How an order runs
- 1. Brief: capacity, neck, material, quantity, market, decoration (1–2 days).
- 2. DFM check against 3,000+ moulds and a 3D drawing if the shape is new (5 days).
- 3. Quotation with unit price, packing data, lead time and incoterm (within 24 hours).
- 4. Sample from the production mould, not a showroom piece (7 days; 25 days if new tooling).
- 5. Deposit, production 25–35 days, final inspection, shipment (EXW / FOB / CIF).
- Seller of record: Shantou Chuangxin Weinuo Plastic Packaging Products Co., Ltd. Quotations, contracts and invoices are issued by CXWN.

## Frequently asked
- Q: What is your minimum order quantity? A: 1,000 pcs per colour on an existing mould. Below that we can quote stock colours from inventory.
- Q: Is there a tooling cost? A: No on the 3,000+ moulds we already hold. A new blow mould starts at USD 800 and takes 15–20 days; an injection mould for a cap starts at USD 3,500.
- Q: How long does production take? A: 25–35 days after sample approval for stock colours. Custom colours and heavy decoration add 5–7 days.
- Q: Can I get a sample before ordering? A: Yes. Samples from existing moulds are free, freight collect, and leave within 7 days.
- Q: Which compliance documents do you hold? A: ISO 9001:2015 (certificate PCC85724Q01277R1S), a RoHS verification of compliance, and an EU 10/2011 + 1935/2004 overall migration test on PE grades. PET and PETG declarations are issued per order.
- Q: Can you match a specific colour? A: Yes, to a Pantone reference. Colour matching is quoted per colour and the MOQ applies per colour.
- Q: What decoration can you apply? A: Silkscreen in 1–4 colours, hot stamping, spray coating (matte, gloss or soft-touch) and label application. MOQ is 1,000 pcs for silkscreen and labels, 3,000 pcs for hot stamp and spray.
- Q: Can you copy a bottle I already have? A: Yes. Send a sample or a drawing — we check it against the 3,000+ moulds on the shelf first, because an existing mould means no tooling cost and no 20-day wait.
